verses.ar: فَأَجَابَ صُوفَرُ ٱلنَّعْمَاتِيُّ وَقَالَ:
verses.kjv: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said,
verses.web: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

verses.ar: «مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَلِكَ هَوَاجِسِي تُجِيبُنِي، وَلِهَذَا هَيَجَانِي فِيَّ.
verses.kjv: Therefore do my thoughts cause me to answer, and for [this] I make haste.
verses.web: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

verses.ar: تَعْيِيرَ تَوْبِيخِي أَسْمَعُ. وَرُوحٌ مِنْ فَهْمِي يُجِيبُنِي.
verses.kjv: I have heard the check of my reproach, and the spirit of my understanding causeth me to answer.
verses.web: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

verses.ar: «أَمَا عَلِمْتَ هَذَا مِنَ ٱلْقَدِيمِ، مُنْذُ وُضِعَ ٱلْإِنْسَانُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ،
verses.kjv: Knowest thou [not] this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
verses.web: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

verses.ar: أَنَّ هُتَافَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ، وَفَرَحَ ٱلْفَاجِرِ إِلَى لَحْظَةٍ!
verses.kjv: That the triumphing of the wicked [is] short, and the joy of the hypocrite [but] for a moment?
verses.web: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

verses.ar: وَلَوْ بَلَغَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ طُولُهُ، وَمَسَّ رَأْسُهُ ٱلسَّحَابَ،
verses.kjv: Though his excellency mount up to the heavens, and his head reach unto the clouds;
verses.web: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

verses.ar: كَجُلَّتِهِ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ يَبِيدُ. ٱلَّذِينَ رَأَوْهُ يَقُولُونَ: أَيْنَ هُوَ؟
verses.kjv: [Yet] he shall perish for ever like his own dung: they which have seen him shall say, Where [is] he?
verses.web: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

verses.ar: كَٱلْحُلْمِ يَطِيرُ فَلَا يُوجَدُ، وَيُطْرَدُ كَطَيْفِ ٱللَّيْلِ.
verses.kjv: He shall fly away as a dream, and shall not be found: yea, he shall be chased away as a vision of the night.
verses.web: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

verses.ar: عَيْنٌ أَبْصَرَتْهُ لَا تَعُودُ تَرَاهُ، وَمَكَانُهُ لَنْ يَرَاهُ بَعْدُ.
verses.kjv: The eye also [which] saw him shall [see him] no more; neither shall his place any more behold him.
verses.web: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

verses.ar: بَنُوهُ يَتَرَضَّوْنَ ٱلْفُقَرَاءَ، وَيَدَاهُ تَرُدَّانِ ثَرْوَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: His children shall seek to please the poor, and his hands shall restore their goods.
verses.web: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

verses.ar: عِظَامُهُ مَلآنَةٌ شَبِيبَةً، وَمَعَهُ فِي ٱلتُّرَابِ تَضْطَجِعُ.
verses.kjv: His bones are full [of the sin] of his youth, which shall lie down with him in the dust.
verses.web: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

verses.ar: إِنْ حَلَا فِي فَمِهِ ٱلشَّرُّ، وَأَخْفَاهُ تَحْتَ لِسَانِهِ،
verses.kjv: Though wickedness be sweet in his mouth, [though] he hide it under his tongue;
verses.web: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

verses.ar: أَشْفَقَ عَلَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَتْرُكْهُ، بَلْ حَبَسَهُ وَسَطَ حَنَكِهِ،
verses.kjv: [Though] he spare it, and forsake it not; but keep it still within his mouth:
verses.web: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

verses.ar: فَخُبْزُهُ فِي أَمْعَائِهِ يَتَحَوَّلُ، مَرَارَةَ أَصْلَالٍ فِي بَطْنِهِ.
verses.kjv: [Yet] his meat in his bowels is turned, [it is] the gall of asps within him.
verses.web: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

verses.ar: قَدْ بَلَعَ ثَرْوَةً فَيَتَقَيَّأُهَا. ٱللهُ يَطْرُدُهَا مِنْ بَطْنِهِ.
verses.kjv: He hath swallowed down riches, and he shall vomit them up again: God shall cast them out of his belly.
verses.web: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

verses.ar: سَمَّ ٱلْأَصْلَالِ يَرْضَعُ. يَقْتُلُهُ لِسَانُ ٱلْأَفْعَى.
verses.kjv: He shall suck the poison of asps: the viper’s tongue shall slay him.
verses.web: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

verses.ar: لَا يَرَى ٱلْجَدَاوِلَ أَنْهَارَ سَوَاقِيَ عَسَلٍ وَلَبَنٍ.
verses.kjv: He shall not see the rivers, the floods, the brooks of honey and butter.
verses.web: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

verses.ar: يَرُدُّ تَعَبَهُ وَلَا يَبْلَعُهُ. كَمَالٍ تَحْتَ رَجْعٍ. وَلَا يَفْرَحُ.
verses.kjv: That which he laboured for shall he restore, and shall not swallow [it] down: according to [his] substance [shall] the restitution [be], and he shall not rejoice [therein].
verses.web: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ رَضَّضَ ٱلْمَسَاكِينَ، وَتَرَكَهُمْ، وَٱغْتَصَبَ بَيْتًا وَلَمْ يَبْنِهِ.
verses.kjv: Because he hath oppressed [and] hath forsaken the poor; [because] he hath violently taken away an house which he builded not;
verses.web: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ يَعْرِفْ فِي بَطْنِهِ قَنَاعَةً، لَا يَنْجُو بِمُشْتَهَاهُ.
verses.kjv: Surely he shall not feel quietness in his belly, he shall not save of that which he desired.
verses.web: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

verses.ar: لَيْسَتْ مِنْ أَكْلِهِ بَقِيَّةٌ، لِأَجْلِ ذَلِكَ لَا يَدُومُ خَيْرُهُ.
verses.kjv: There shall none of his meat be left; therefore shall no man look for his goods.
verses.web: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

verses.ar: مَعَ مِلْءِ رَغْدِهِ يَتَضَايَقُ. تَأْتِي عَلَيْهِ يَدُ كُلِّ شَقِيٍّ.
verses.kjv: In the fulness of his sufficiency he shall be in straits: every hand of the wicked shall come upon him.
verses.web: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

verses.ar: يَكُونُ عِنْدَمَا يَمْلَأُ بَطْنَهُ، أَنَّ ٱللهَ يُرْسِلُ عَلَيْهِ حُمُوَّ غَضَبِهِ، وَيُمْطِرُهُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ.
verses.kjv: [When] he is about to fill his belly, [God] shall cast the fury of his wrath upon him, and shall rain [it] upon him while he is eating.
verses.web: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

verses.ar: يَفِرُّ مِنْ سِلَاحِ حَدِيدٍ. تَخْرِقُهُ قَوْسُ نُحَاسٍ.
verses.kjv: He shall flee from the iron weapon, [and] the bow of steel shall strike him through.
verses.web: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

verses.ar: جَذَبَهُ فَخَرَجَ مِنْ بَطْنِهِ، وَٱلْبَارِقُ مِنْ مَرَارَتِهِ مَرَقَ. عَلَيْهِ رُعُوبٌ.
verses.kjv: It is drawn, and cometh out of the body; yea, the glittering sword cometh out of his gall: terrors [are] upon him.
verses.web: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

verses.ar: كُلُّ ظُلْمَةٍ مُخْتَبَأَةٌ لِذَخَائِرِهِ. تَأْكُلُهُ نَارٌ لَمْ تُنْفَخْ. تَرْعَى ٱلْبَقِيَّةَ فِي خَيْمَتِهِ.
verses.kjv: All darkness [shall be] hid in his secret places: a fire not blown shall consume him; it shall go ill with him that is left in his tabernacle.
verses.web: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

verses.ar: ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ تُعْلِنُ إِثْمَهُ، وَٱلْأَرْضُ تَنْهَضُ عَلَيْهِ.
verses.kjv: The heaven shall reveal his iniquity; and the earth shall rise up against him.
verses.web: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

verses.ar: تَزُولُ غَلَّةُ بَيْتِهِ. تُهْرَاقُ فِي يَوْمِ غَضَبِهِ.
verses.kjv: The increase of his house shall depart, [and his goods] shall flow away in the day of his wrath.
verses.web: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

verses.ar: هَذَا نَصِيبُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱللهِ، وَمِيرَاثُ أَمْرِهِ مِنَ ٱلْقَدِيرِ».
verses.kjv: This [is] the portion of a wicked man from God, and the heritage appointed unto him by God.
verses.web: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”
